summary: The bounded harness audit completed successfully. A spec-first PR-177 implementation is feasible, but implementation and any candidate label must remain blocked until the integer support endpoints are adjudicated, a content-pinned matched-mask authority is frozen, the PR-152 raw-record identity is separated from its obsolete L=2..10 analysis configuration, and the PR-173 dependence-aware numerical-resolution obligation is implemented. The recommended producer is sequential, low-priority, checkpointed, and one-pass over the 401 authenticated raw units; deterministic checks operate only on small pinned authority files and content-addressed sufficient-statistic caches.

claim_results.scope: Harness and resource architecture only; no estimator result, implementation, or scientific claim was reviewed.
blocking_gaps: Resolve whether the integer support is 41..762 or 40..763 and freeze one exact set before any result-producing run.
Create and pin an explicit baseline-mask input record and freeze the matched leakage-control transform.
Adopt PR-152 raw records through an immutable authority chain without adopting its L=2..10 config or cache.
Produce the full dependence-aware delete-unit recomputation required by PR-173 before routing to any resolved terminal state.

findings.title: The exact integer support is internally inconsistent

evidence_refs.fact: The card repeatedly writes 40<L<763, which is the integer set 41..762.
The registered assignment requests 40<=L<=763, which is the integer set 40..763.
The upstream metadata represents the release range as the closed pair [40,763], without resolving the prose inequality.

findings.consequence: The alternatives contain 722 and 724 integer multipoles respectively. They change the estimator, cache key, mode count, mutation fixtures, and potentially the selected result. Silent interpretation would redefine an authoritative gate after intake.
findings.required_remediation: Before implementation, add a spec field containing the exact sorted integer support and an endpoint-adjudication note. Bind that set into the config hash, producer cache key, result card, manifest, and endpoint mutations. Do not begin the heavy run while the ambiguity remains.

findings.title: The reusable PR-152 payload identity is embedded in a low-L analysis manifest

evidence_refs.fact: The card contains one data record and 400 ordered unique simulation records with path, size, and SHA-256, but the same manifest also binds ell_min=2, ell_max=10, seed, mode weights, and the PR-152 producer.
The immutable small-file chain pins the card SHA-256 e94c1554... and ordered manifest SHA-256 dbb4b1f1..., while the cached sufficient statistics are specifically the low-L cache.
PR-152 already hashed every raw byte and made same-count replacement, non-head mutation, band drift, and producer drift select a new cache.

evidence_refs.locator: input authentication and source authority receipts
evidence_refs.fact: PR-173 establishes the accepted pattern of hashing small metadata and consuming upstream manifest authority without repeating raw-payload hashes.

measured_inventory.derived_digest_definition: SHA-256 of canonical sorted-key compact JSON containing only data_alm and ordered_simulation_alms from the authenticated PR-152 card

findings.consequence: Using the whole PR-152 manifest as the PR-177 config would falsely retain L=2..10 semantics; using the PR-152 cache would be out of band. Rehashing 64.15 GB at each write/check would duplicate already authenticated work and contend with PR-151 acquisition.
findings.required_remediation: Freeze the exact PR-152 artifact-manifest and card byte hashes in the pre-result PR-177 spec. The checker must reopen and hash those small files, verify their cross-pins, recompute the embedded ordered-manifest digest, and derive a separately named raw-record root. PR-177 then binds its own estimator/spec/mask/producer hashes to that root. Never trust cache_binding_verified as a scalar assertion, never reuse the low-L cache, and never hash the 401 raw payloads during routine --check.

findings.title: PR-152 does not provide an explicit baseline-mask content pin

evidence_refs.fact: The upstream manifest records only a prose mask-lineage status; the raw pins contain the card, low-L cache, and ordered input manifest, not a path/size/SHA-256 mask record.

The release states that the mask was applied before the quadratic reconstruction and that harmonic-space work must account for its nontrivial coupling, with the same treatment repeated on the 400 simulations.

evidence_refs.locator: PR-177 DoD and kill switch, lines 4928-4936
evidence_refs.fact: Mask leakage reproducing the coupling is an explicit candidate kill switch.

findings.consequence: A data/simulation pipeline can be byte-reproducible yet still self-consistently omit, change, or post-hoc redefine the mask leakage control. That would permit a false candidate from deterministic survey-window coupling.
findings.required_remediation: Before results, authenticate the baseline mask as a typed path/size/SHA-256 input and freeze the exact harmonic-space mask operation, leakage template, overlap statistic, threshold, and terminal routing. Apply one common feature extractor to data and all simulations; any leave-one-out leakage template must be recomputed with the same rule for every scored unit. Bind the mask record and control config into every per-unit cache and final manifest.

findings.title: PR-173 requires dependence-aware full cross-fit delete-unit recomputation

evidence_refs.fact: The exact conditional 146/401 identity is explicitly not an MC-error certificate because all cross-fit scores share observation- and simulation-derived mean fields; the required method is full_crossfit_delete_independent_unit_recomputation.
The 400 release band powers are exchangeable null units, not authenticated independent seed estimates of an observed-minus-mean estimand.

evidence_refs.locator: PR-177 terminal labels and kill switch, lines 4930-4936
evidence_refs.fact: An unresolved MC decision must block the candidate and route to NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED_AT_CURRENT_MC_BUDGET.

findings.consequence: A naive empirical tail fraction, iid binomial interval, or reuse of PR-152's pooled-rank arithmetic would violate the completed PR-173 dependency and could promote a finite-ensemble fluctuation to the candidate branch.
findings.required_remediation: Freeze the unit-level statistic and all thresholds before extraction. After the 401 deterministic unit features exist, perform the complete observation-inclusive cross-fit score reconstruction and the registered delete-independent-unit recomputation at the feature layer. Store replicate identities, deletion unit, tie policy, interval construction, boundary, and guard interval. Candidate and no-resolved branches require the entire guard interval to lie on the preregistered side; a crossing interval or invalid dependence route must emit only NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED_AT_CURRENT_MC_BUDGET with candidate fields null.

findings.title: The 64.15 GB read should be one-pass, resumable, and isolated from cheap adjudication

evidence_refs.fact: The authenticated inventory is one 96,079,680-byte data file plus 400 160,128,000-byte simulation files.

evidence_refs.locator: Data and resource state; Open questions and kill switches
evidence_refs.fact: PR-151 is a live low-priority NVMe acquisition; new NVMe-heavy work is disallowed below 300 GiB and must not race tracked-artifact writes.

findings.consequence: A monolithic or parallel producer would increase memory and I/O pressure, lose all progress after interruption, and make routine validation unnecessarily reread raw payloads. A self-asserted cache card would allow coordinated stale-cache false greens.
findings.required_remediation: Use an extraction phase that processes exactly one unit at a time with worker count fixed to one, thread caps, requested/effective nice and I/O-priority receipts, a preflight disk/resource gate, and atomic per-unit checkpoints keyed by raw record, spec, estimator, mask, and producer hashes. Resume only verified completed units. A separate aggregation/write phase reads only the small feature cache, recomputes the mask control, cross-fit/delete-unit certificates, terminal route, mutation report, and manifest. The --check path must be read-only, reject any extra/missing/duplicate unit or stale hash, recompute all scientific fields from cached primitives, and never open or rehash raw ALM payloads.

proposed_changes.change: Freeze docs/research_program/long_horizon_rescue/pr177_spec.yaml before any heavy output. The spec must contain exact integer support, estimator equations and normalization, selected feature/scan, tie policy, thresholds, leakage-control definition, numerical-resolution method, terminal routing, and forbidden claims.

Introduce a small immutable PR-152 authority adapter that pins and revalidates the PR-152 manifest/card bytes, verifies nested cross-pins, and exports a raw-record-only root. Keep PR-177 config and producer identity separate; do not reuse the L=2..10 cache.

Authenticate the baseline mask and any estimator-relevant filter/control inputs with typed path/size/SHA-256 records. Freeze an identical data/simulation mask operation and a mask-leakage kill statistic before results.

Build a one-worker extraction CLI with deterministic unit IDs data, sim-0001..sim-0400; one raw file is loaded at a time, sufficient statistics are atomically cached, and resource-policy receipts record effective process/thread/I/O settings.

Build a cheap aggregate runner that validates the complete cache, reconstructs all cross-fit and delete-unit primitives, applies the frozen mask and MC gates, writes result/control/mutation/manifest artifacts atomically, and supports byte-reproducible --write and read-only --check.

Update PR-177 delta and status only after strict DAG validation, producer/check receipts, targeted tests, smoke, mutation closure, independent review, and a final manifest check. Keep PR-151 solely background and do not touch its tracked artifacts.

risks_and_kill_switches: Endpoint ambiguity or any support outside the adjudicated in-band integer set blocks extraction and candidate routing.
Any missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, or unauthenticated release simulation blocks the result; exactly 400 means IDs 0001 through 0400 once each.
Any data/simulation callable, config, mask, weight, normalization, or dtype mismatch blocks the result.
Mask leakage meeting the frozen reproduction/overlap condition blocks the candidate regardless of primary score.
An invalid dependence method, incomplete delete-unit lineage, or guard interval crossing the decision boundary routes only to NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED_AT_CURRENT_MC_BUDGET.
Any small-file authority mismatch or cache/spec/producer/mask hash drift blocks check; routine check must not repair or reseal artifacts.
The producer must refuse a second worker and stop before heavy I/O if the shared resource/disk gate fails; it must never start or stop PR-151 processes.
No output may say detection, raw-QE reproduction, sky signal, anisotropy, geometry, Bianchi family identification, or native solver validation.
